\section{Introduction}\label{sec:intro}

A paper pipeline that keeps markdown as the source of truth has to translate
it into the LaTeX its venue expects. Routing that through a general converter
costs 100\% of the control over R\&D\_notation and the file names
\cite{coronado-2022-ztn-survey,du-2023}.

\subsection{What the mapping fixes}\label{what-the-mapping-fixes}

The correspondence is written once and holds in both directions:

\begin{itemize}
\item chapter and figure file names match across formats
\item a caption is written once, as alt text or a caption line
\item the emitted LaTeX stays close to what an author hand-writes
\end{itemize}

Section \ref{sec:floats} shows the floats, and Figure \ref{fig:pipeline} the
shape of the conversion.
